verdicts.reason: A breaks the headline awkwardly ('Chase the / Light'), squeezes the body copy into a narrow five-line column with an orphaned 'hour.', and drops that copy beside the CTA instead of under the headline, so the reading order is jumbled; its SOLSTICE logo is also tiny and buried in the circle. B keeps the headline on one line with clean two-line copy stacked above the CTA, but the headline and CTA sit almost against the right edge, the NEW FLAVOR badge is crammed against the top-left corner, and the small logo floats on its own in a mostly empty left side.
